scope: Primary source inspection; not an upstream deployment result
finding: Linux v6.12 IPv4 and IPv6 original-destination handlers copy the family sockaddr but do not update the supplied optlen. Mitmproxy supplies exactly 16 or 28 bytes. Envoy allocates sockaddr_storage but does not require the returned optlen to equal the smaller family structure. GoldenHoop supplied sizeof(sockaddr_storage) and required family-sized returned lengths, rejecting valid redirections.
constraints: Keep exact family/structure validation, actual SO_ORIGINAL_DST, native source identity, policy, lease, audit and collection. Do not substitute local socket address or weaken a failed identity observation.
